title: Second Nature AI Review: Strengths, Limits and Who It Fits
summary: Our Second Nature AI review covers its avatar role plays, courses, scoring, LMS and security claims, open questions, who it fits and what to test first.
body_markdown:
Test


What to do


Score 2 when


Scenario from your content


Upload one real deck or talk track and generate a role play


The persona and evaluation topics match your product without rewrites


Avatar value


Run the same scenario as voice only and as an avatar


Managers can name a behavior the avatar version trained that voice did not


Scoring fit


Replace the default 70/30 weighting with your rubric


Two managers agree with the score on three sessions


Evidence


Open a low score


Each criterion points to a moment in the transcript


Certification path


Build a two-task course with a pass rule


A rep who fails knows what to fix and can retry


LMS handoff


Push one course through SCORM or LTI


Completion and scores show in your LMS


Language


Have a native speaker run the scenario in your target language


The buyer sounds natural and the feedback is accurate


Devices


Run sessions on the laptops, tablets or phones your reps use


No session fails to load or record
